_why: Deliberate breakages, each of a promise the code makes, with the test file that has to go red. tools/mutate.mjs applies one at a time and puts the file back; a mutant that survives means the test guarding that promise proves nothing, and a mutant that no longer applies means the code moved out from under the check. Both fail a run. test/mutate.test.js holds every entry here against today's source on every push without running any of them. Add a mutant when a test is written for something a user would notice losing; never delete one to make a run green.

mutants.name: deployPack allocates a slot instead of reusing its own
deployPack ignores slots that are occupied
deployMemberAsMod writes over the pack it came from
combining drops a contested file without saying so
